question: Among healthcare providers whose practice location is in Mountain View, CA, and who have a specified specialization in the field healthcare provider taxonomy, identify the top 10 most common specializations based on the count of distinct NPIs. Then determine which of those top 10 has a count of distinct NPIs closest to the average count across those 10 specializations.
sql:
WITH mountain_view_npis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT npi
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized`
  WHERE provider_business_practice_location_address_city_name = 'MOUNTAIN VIEW'
    AND provider_business_practice_location_address_state_name = 'CA'
),
npi_taxonomy AS (
  SELECT npi, 
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1 as tc1,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_2 as tc2,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_3 as tc3,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_4 as tc4,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_5 as tc5,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_6 as tc6,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_7 as tc7,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_8 as tc8,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_9 as tc9,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_10 as tc10,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_11 as tc11,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_12 as tc12,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_13 as tc13,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_14 as tc14,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_15 as tc15
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized`
  WHERE npi IN (SELECT npi FROM mountain_view_npis)
),
unpivot_taxonomy AS (
  SELECT npi, tc1 as taxonomy_code FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc2 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc3 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc4 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc5 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc6 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc7 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc8 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc9 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc10 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc11 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc12 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc13 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc14 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc15 FROM npi_taxonomy
),
specialization_counts AS (
  SELECT t.specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT ut.npi) as distinct_npi_count
  FROM unpivot_taxonomy ut
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nppes.healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_set` t
    ON ut.taxonomy_code = t.code
  WHERE t.specialization IS NOT NULL AND t.specialization != ''
  GROUP BY t.specialization
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT specialization, distinct_npi_count
  FROM specialization_counts
  ORDER BY distinct_npi_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_npi_count) as avg_count FROM top10
)
SELECT t.specialization, t.distinct_npi_count
FROM top10 t, avg_calc a
ORDER BY ABS(t.distinct_npi_count - a.avg_count) ASC
LIMIT 1
